result.responsePreview:
Work Board loop plan for fixing the flaky OAuth refresh test:

- Template/pattern: Issue-specific flaky test fix with CI verification
- Acceptance gates:
  - Local lint passes clean
  - Typecheck passes clean
  - The targeted OAuth refresh test passes consistently when run focused
- Required receipts:
  - Successful CI build or local command output verifying conditions
- Attempt/runtime/token/cost budget:
  - Up to 5 retry attempts max
  - Each attempt runs lint, typecheck, and focused test
- Handoff/block rule:
  - If failures are traced to auth misconfiguration or external dependency authentication blocks, stop and hand off
- Readiness audit:
  - Confirm no other unrelated errors cause test failure
  - Verify test flakiness reliably reproduces before fix

I will start by locating the OAuth refresh test, reproducing the flaky failure, and identifying flaky sources such as timing, async waits, network mocks, or race conditions. Then I will patch and rerun the validation suite until stable. If I hit auth block, I will report and hand off.
